# One run = one flow: the config file names the source, the sink and how to load.
import json
raw = mssparkutils.fs.head(f"abfss://config@lumenfreightlake.dfs.core.windows.net/{config_path}", 1024 * 1024)
cfg = json.loads(raw)
flow = cfg["flow_name"]
if not cfg.get("active", True):
    mssparkutils.notebook.exit(f"{flow}: inactive, skipped")

schema, table = cfg["sink"]["schema"], cfg["sink"]["table"]
mode = "overwrite" if cfg.get("load_type", "full") == "full" else "append"
df.write.mode(mode).format("delta").save(f"abfss://lake@lumenfreightlake.dfs.core.windows.net/bronze/{schema}/{table}")
print(f"{flow}: {df.count()} rows -> bronze/{schema}/{table}")
